name: postfx
description: Effects on the whole picture of the world, as a camera would add them: a soft glow around bright things, darkened corners, film grain, a colour grade, and black bars for a cinematic moment. The interface is drawn after them and never touched. Presentation only: nothing in the simulation changes.

components.name: Effects
components.description: The effects of the picture (only the oldest Effects is used; put it on the camera, for example). bloom (0 to 1) makes bright parts glow over what is around them. vignette (0 to 1) darkens the corners, from vignette_size (the share of the way from the middle to a corner where it starts). grain (0 to 1) lays a fine moving grain, as on film. tint_red, tint_green and tint_blue (0 to 255) multiply every colour (255, 255, 255 changes nothing: a cold night is blue, a warm evening orange); lift_red, lift_green and lift_blue are added everywhere (0 changes nothing: dark parts take that colour). letterbox (0 to 1) is the share of the height covered by black bars at the top and bottom; a tween can slide it in and out for a cut scene.

systems.name: apply
systems.description: Tells the renderer the effects of the frame, from the oldest Effects.
